issues.title: Drug Pricing & Access
issues.hover_description: High drug prices restrict patient access. ESRS S2/S3 community impact. Reputational risk if access gap is publicised (S&P ESG score -8%).

issues.title: Clinical Trials Ethics
issues.hover_description: ESRS S2: risks of exploitative trials in low-income countries. Regulatory sanction risk under ICH E6 (R3) and EMA guidelines.

issues.title: Pharmaceutical Waste in Waterways
issues.hover_description: Active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) in effluents. ESRS E3 (water) - biodiversity impact. EU Pharmaceutical Strategy calls for enhanced wastewater treatment.

issues.title: Manufacturing GHG Emissions
issues.hover_description: Pharma manufacturing is energy-intensive. Scope 1 & 2 emissions subject to EU ETS. Carbon cost exposure: EUR60-110/tCO2 by 2030.

issues.title: R&D IP Concentration & Antibiotic Resistance
issues.hover_description: Underfunding of antibiotic R&D due to low ROI. ESRS G1 systemic risk. AMR causes 1.27M deaths/year; WHO declares global emergency.

issues.title: Supply Chain Labour Conditions (API Suppliers)
issues.hover_description: API manufacturing concentrated in India & China. ESRS S2: forced labour and unsafe conditions risk in Tier-2/3 suppliers.

issues.title: Counterfeit Medicines & Supply Chain Integrity
issues.hover_description: 10% of medicines in low-income markets are counterfeit (WHO). Patient safety risk and brand liability. ESRS G1 traceability gap.

issues.title: Biodiversity Impact - Natural Compound Sourcing
issues.hover_description: Extracting compounds from threatened species and habitats. ESRS E4 (biodiversity). CBD Nagoya Protocol compliance risk.

issues.title: Pandemic Preparedness & Vaccine Equity
issues.hover_description: ESRS S3: Failure to provide affordable vaccines in LMIC during outbreaks. WHO Essential Medicines List pressure. IP waiver debate (TRIPS).

issues.title: Product Safety Recalls
issues.hover_description: Post-market safety failures trigger FDA/EMA recalls. ESRS G1: liability and governance risk. Avg. recall cost: $100M-$600M per event.

interdependencies.description: Access gaps incentivise cheaper trial populations
Same production process drives both water and air impact
